propositions: The live completion-verifier eval builds a single PydanticAIRunner before entering per-case disposable repositories, causing its LLMConfig.repo_path to point to the eval checkout rather than the fixture root.

The runner._effective_config method substitutes only per-request model/limit tuning and preserves the base repo_path, so agentic filesystem and ticket tools read the checkout instead of each case fixture.
The fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner for each disposable case store and clears tickets_path, ensuring agents read their own fixture code and seeded ticket store.

The completion-verifier standing eval previously failed with epoch_pass [False, False, False] on targeted complete cases that depend on fixture files (src/cli.py, app/profile.py), while operator-attested cases (which need no fixture code) passed.
